question: The Gahadavalas ruled over which region of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanauj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gahadavalas:-**

 
 
• **The Gahadavalas were a dynasty of Indian rulers who held power in the region of Kanauj during the medieval period. **
 
• The Gahadavalas came to power in the 11th century CE and ruled over Kanauj for several centuries. They were known for their patronage of the arts and their support of Hinduism.
 
• The Gahadavalas faced numerous challenges during their rule, including invasions by Muslim rulers from the north and internal power struggles. Despite these difficulties, they were able to maintain their hold on Kanauj for several centuries.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kanauj**:-

 
 
• It was an important political and cultural center in northern India during this time.
 
• It was located on the banks of the Ganges River and was known for its wealth and strategic location.
 
 
 
• **Ajmer**:-
 
 
• It was a city located in present-day Rajasthan that was ruled by various dynasties throughout history.
 
 
 
• **Malwa**:-
 
 
• It was a region in central India that was ruled by the Paramara dynasty during the medieval period. 
 
 
 
• **Patan**:-
 
 
• It was a city in present-day Gujarat that was ruled by the Solanki dynasty during the medieval period.
